rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for all the things under discussion.

example.traditional: 我已經準備好所有嘢喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 so2 jau5 je5 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the meaning is anything and everything, without choosing particular items.

example.english: They eat everything; they really don't mind.
example.traditional: 佢乜嘢都食，真係冇所謂。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mat1 je5 dou1 sik6 zan1 hai6 mou5 so2 wai6

rows.note: Use this for all the effort or strength someone can summon, usually in a phrase such as 用盡全力.

example.english: We'll do everything we can to help you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 jung6 zeon6 cyun4 lik6 bong1 nei5

rows.note: Use this when everything means the most important thing, as in timing being the most important thing.

example.traditional: 對我嚟講，時間係最重要嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 si4 gaan1 hai6 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 je5
